selection_basis: Six additional human targets spanning six biological processes; nominated from literature and curated records before scoring. No model scores were used in target or partner selection.

positives.note: Direct KRAS-RAF1 RBD/CRD complex; binding depends on the KRAS nucleotide state.
Direct KRAS contact in the RAS/RAF recruitment complex; binding alone does not imply BRAF activation.
NMR-supported KRAS-ARAF RAS-binding-domain interaction in a membrane context. The three RAF partners are homologous and are not independent biological families.
Cyclin A2 directly binds CDK2 in the crystallized cyclin A-CDK2-p27 complex.
Human cyclin E1-CDK2 complex; kinase activity additionally depends on phosphorylation.
The p27 inhibitory domain directly contacts CDK2 and cyclin A in the ternary structure.
Curated human HIF1A-ARNT heterodimer; structural support from the HIF-1alpha:ARNT DNA-bound complex (PDB 4ZPR).
Direct recognition of a hydroxylated HIF1A peptide by VHL; canonical sequence input does not encode the required proline hydroxylation.
HIF1A C-terminal activation domain directly binds the p300 CH1 domain; oxygen-dependent modifications regulate recruitment.
Curated human beta-catenin-E-cadherin interaction; E-cadherin cytoplasmic tail binds beta-catenin. Homologous structural support: PDB 1I7X (murine proteins).
Curated human beta-catenin-alpha-E-catenin interaction; distinct from alpha-N-catenin (CTNNA2).
Direct beta-catenin-TCF4 (TCF7L2) binding supports Wnt-dependent transcription.
Curated direct TNF-TNFR1 ligand-receptor binding; TNF exists as membrane-bound precursor and cleaved soluble ligand.
Human soluble lymphotoxin-alpha homotrimer directly binds TNFR1; distinct from lymphotoxin-alpha/beta receptor specificity.
Direct interaction of TRADD and TNFR1 death domains; downstream complex membership alone is not used as positive evidence.
Human ATG14 coiled-coil interaction with Beclin 1; mutually exclusive with UVRAG-containing complexes.
Curated human BECN1-BCL2 interaction through the Beclin 1 BH3 domain; structural support in PDB 5VAX uses an engineered BCL2/BCL2L1 construct.
